concepts.name: small transformer
concepts.definition: A small transformer that uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training.

concepts.name: self attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism used by a small transformer to process text.

concepts.name: text
concepts.definition: The input data processed by self-attention.

concepts.name: backpropagation
concepts.definition: A mechanism used by a small transformer to improve its predictions during training.

concepts.name: prediction
concepts.definition: The outputs of a small transformer that are improved during training via backpropagation.

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: The context in which a small transformer uses self-attention and backpropagation.

concepts.name: regularization
concepts.definition: A technique applied to machine learning models.

concepts.name: generalization beyond training example
concepts.definition: The ability of a model to perform well on unseen data.

concepts.name: quantization
concepts.definition: a process that reduces memory requirements after training

concepts.name: retrieval augmented generation
concepts.definition: a method that lets a system use external documents when answering questions

concepts.name: memory requirement
concepts.definition: the amount of memory needed by a process

concepts.name: external document
concepts.definition: documents used to answer questions outside the model's internal knowledge

concepts.name: use of external document
concepts.definition: the act of utilizing external documents when answering questions

concepts.name: query vector
concepts.definition: The query vector associated with a specific token in the input sequence.

concepts.name: key vector
concepts.definition: The key vector associated with another specific token in the input sequence.

concepts.name: similarity score
concepts.definition: A raw similarity score computed between a specific pair of token vectors.

concepts.name: normalized attention weight
concepts.definition: A probability distribution value representing the attention weight for a specific token pair, derived from the exponential of the similarity score divided by the sum of all such exponentials.
